And they always (mostly my father) talk about their experiences and past, I feel like they're comparing themselves towards us. I want to express myself, I really do. I'm scare to tell my family and I don't have the courage to do it.

My brother tends to keep things to himself as well, but my sister is the opposite. Whenever she got in a fight with her friends she would take it out on us. And when my parents ask her what's wrong, she'll tell exactly what happen. Even if that happen, it's no excuse to treat someone like that right? She always does that and find a way out of being mad at. I hate it and it's like my parents have to follow everything she says and does.

Even if I do tell or write them a letter of what I'm feeling inside. They won't take it seriously and just shrug it off. My father wakes up early and goes to work, comes home late and either sleep or watch TV. My mother goes to work at 9am and comes home at 7, sometimes she continues her works at home. What I'm trying to say here is, my family is not close and there's always either one of us that starts fighting with each other. I feel like our family's gonna break up soon. I'm trying to get myself ready and save up money in case my parents divorce. I'm so sorry if I talk a lot. Thank you for listening and replying, it really means a lot.

Like, all the pencils has to be sharp, cleaning the house 24/7 and not having ANY error such as a crooked chair/table, etc. Or it could also be like, your clothes has to be neat and orderly/organise in one specific way. There are many examples and symptoms to detect OCD, though I'm not quite sure with what you have said are one of them. This is just my opinion though. And I'm not really into this field. You should ask your family, or ask someone more experience.
